submission.natural_language_explanation: This head fires strongly on the comma that closes a mid-sentence comma-delimited insertion (an appositive, non-restrictive relative clause, or participial aside), attending with near-1.0 weight back to that insertion's opening comma. It is weaker on single/unpaired commas and dash-delimited insertion closers, and inactive on opening commas and short comma-free plain sentences.
